title: Assess the efficacy of biodegradation and complete mineralization of PFASs and degradation products by enriched microbial cultures
description: Mixed anaerobic and aerobic microbial communities that include known dehalogenators will be cultured with a range of short- and long-chain untreated and nanomaterial-treated PFASs to measure the removal efficacy and mineralization of PFASs.
